name: update_shader
description: You MUST load the figma-shaders skill before calling this tool. If it is not installed, read skill://figma/figma-shaders/SKILL.md with resources/read or get_figma_skill. Use this when the user asks to update, revise, or republish an existing Figma shader, shader effect, shader fill, custom effect, custom fill, or procedural shader. Updates an existing shader effect or fill in the authenticated user's account library. Provide its id, matching kind, existing authored files to replace, optional name, description, animation, and mouse metadata, and a required Git commit message describing the change. The update is built, versioned, and deployed; the response includes the new version. Use create_shader first when no shader exists.

commitMessage.description: A concise title capturing the user's requested goal or change. Describe the intent, not the implementation.

files.description: Existing main.ts to replace. New files cannot be created.

id.description: The id of the existing resource to update.

kind.description: The existing shader kind. It must match the resource identified by id.

description.description: New one-line description for the shader.

isAnimated.description: Whether the shader renders over time.

name.description: New display name for the shader.

usesMouse.description: Whether the shader reads the mouse position.

versionDescription.description: A single-line summary of the actual changes delivered in this version. Focus on the user-visible result.

versionDetail.description: Adds the key implementation detail in 1–2 short sentences. Keep it proportional to the change; a small fix needs only one sentence. Do not repeat the outcome summary or list routine implementation steps. Include only details supported by the work performed.
